name: User selects preset audio and receives DAW speech analysis metrics

planSteps.description: Open http://localhost:3000/ and verify the SpeechLens Studio header (#presetSelect Evaluation Take dropdown and #btnRunAnalysis 'Analyze Speech Take' button) is visible
Select 'Synthetic: Rushed Delivery (Severity 4)' from the #presetSelect ('Evaluation Take:') dropdown and verify #participantFileDisplay, #baselineFileDisplay, and #transcriptInput auto-populate
Verify #masterScoreVal displays '79', #scoreBadge displays 'Localized Anomaly Flagged', #valPace displays '65.7', and #valPausing, #valPitch, #valVolume, and #valClarity each display '100.0'

Verify #studioWorkspace is visible with multi-track canvases (#canvasCh1, #canvasCh2, #canvasRuler, #canvasMinimap), #dialogueWords tokens, #flawCountIndicator showing '1 Flagged', and clicking the 'rushed' entry in #flawsListContainer opens #flawDetailView
